Repiping & Sewer Line Repair for Raleigh’s Older and Newer Homes

When you work with Happy Home, our plumbing offerings are not limited in scope. As local experts in the Raleigh, NC area, our licensed plumbers are familiar with the diverse home landscape that makes up the city. From the historical homes of Oakwood to the urban-suburban residential mix in Midtown, we know how to handle installations, repairs, and retrofits from the oldest to most modern plumbing systems.

Re-piping Services in Raleigh, NC

Old, galvanized steel pipes are common in older homes across the area, which have aged over time. The ongoing wear and tear can lead to pipe breakages and pinhole leaks. Frequent, tedious pipe repairs warrant a conversation about a whole-home re-piping plan. The plumbers at Happy Home assess the health of your existing pipes, offer a comprehensive re-pipe plan, and deliver a superb re-pipe installation.

Sewer Line Repair in Raleigh, NC

Your sewer line is responsible for receiving all wastewater that comes through your home’s drains and sending it out into your city sewer or septic system. Whether you have a classic Raleigh historical home or enjoy modern-day suburban living, this pipe is essential for home drainage. When it clogs or breaks, wastewater can back up to the drains in your home. With our top-of-the-line tools and equipment, the plumbers at Happy Home can run a camera inspection inside the pipe in a minimally invasive way and identify whether the sewer line needs to be repaired. Our crews are highly knowledgeable in repairing these systems and can restore proper flow to your home successfully.

HVAC Zoning Systems & Heat Pump Repair in Raleigh, NC

Humid summers, crisp falls, and mildly cold winters: here in Raleigh, we endure a mostly humid subtropical climate. However, it’s always important to have an HVAC system that covers you during predictable and unpredictable weather occurrences. The licensed technicians at Happy Home work with all major makes and models of HVAC systems, giving you the peace of mind that every repair is conducted with expertise, and your system replacement can be fully customized based on your specific needs.

HVAC Zoning Systems in Raleigh, NC

If specific rooms in your home are not cooling or heating properly, our HVAC team will walk you through an HVAC zoning system solution. Utilizing your existing ductwork, our team can give each room in your home its own thermostat and temperature control environment. It’s a great and efficient option when you’re looking to control which rooms in your home have cooling or heating turned on.

Heat Pump Repair in Raleigh, NC

Heat pumps are well suited to our mild winter seasons, and in a climate like ours they typically deliver more heat per unit of energy consumed than a traditional gas furnace. Since heat pumps are solely responsible for cooling and heating the home, they are used year-round with no breaks, increasing their susceptibility to wear and tear. Whether it’s an unpredictable breakdown or an issue uncovered during routine maintenance, Happy Home is the go-to for on-demand heat pump repair in the Raleigh area.

Air Scrubbers & Whole-Home Dehumidifiers for Raleigh Pollen and Humidity

Spring in Raleigh brings a heavy tree pollen season, with oak, maple, and cedar producing most of it. A visible yellow film settles across the city for several weeks, and indoor allergy symptoms follow it. Summer then trades pollen for humidity, which creates its own comfort and moisture problems. Without the proper systems in place, your ducts can bring these outdoor conditions inside your home. Fortunately, with Happy Home’s indoor air quality systems, we’re able to recommend and install quality products that tackle your biggest concerns.

Air Scrubbers in Raleigh, NC

Air scrubbers are an ideal solution when you’re concerned about bacteria, mold, and allergens entering your home. These units install directly into your existing duct system, treating air and neutralizing active contaminants as they circulate through your home. The Happy Home team can talk you through the specific functionality and science behind this sophisticated system.

Whole-Home Dehumidifiers in Raleigh, NC

Excessive moisture in the home can not only create discomfort for you and your family, but it can impact your home as well. From mold and mildew buildup to warped wooden floors, a whole-home dehumidifier can help reduce the risk of these issues occurring.
